verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Twilio Verify, the designated successor to the Authy API, lists Push as a channel. Nothing in the pack documents number matching, location or context display on push approvals, or admin-enforced MFA policies for Authy. The 'disable future installations' toggle is a user-side device setting, not an admin MFA policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
